import pytest

if pytest.use_correct:
    from correct_python_programs.is_valid_parenthesization import is_valid_parenthesization
else:
    from python_programs.is_valid_parenthesization import is_valid_parenthesization


def test_attack_1():
    # empty string is balanced (depth 0, never negative)
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("") == True


def test_attack_2():
    # single character can never be balanced
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("(") == False
    assert is_valid_parenthesization(")") == False


def test_attack_3():
    # balanced prefix followed by extra opens -> final depth > 0
    # buggy version returns True here because it never checks final depth
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("((") == False
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("()(") == False
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("()()(") == False
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("(())(") == False


def test_attack_4():
    # unclosed nesting -> final depth > 0
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("(()") == False
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("((()") == False
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("((())") == False
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("(((") == False


def test_attack_5():
    # properly nested strings must stay True
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("()") == True
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("(())") == True
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("()()") == True
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("(()())") == True
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("((()()))()") == True


def test_attack_6():
    # equal numbers of '(' and ')' but wrong order -> invalid
    # catches count-only fixes that ignore prefix condition
    assert is_valid_parenthesization(")(") == False
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("))(( ") == False or is_valid_parenthesization("))((") == False
    assert is_valid_parenthesization(")()(") == False
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("())(()") == False


def test_attack_7():
    # examples from the docstring
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("((()()))()") == True
    assert is_valid_parenthesization(")()(") == False


def test_attack_8():
    # larger balanced vs off-by-one unbalanced
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("(" * 50 + ")" * 50) == True
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("()" * 50) == True
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("(" * 50 + ")" * 49) == False
    assert is_valid_parenthesization("(" * 50) == False
    assert is_valid_parenthesization(")" * 50) == False
    assert is_valid_parenthesization(")(" * 50) == False
